name: ConvertTextToBase64Node
label: Convert Text to Base64
description: Encodes a plain text string into a Base64 string using the specified text encoding.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: Text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: The plain text to encode as Base64.

fields.name: TextEncoding
fields.label: Encoding
fields.description: The character encoding used to convert the text to bytes before Base64 encoding.

fields.name: Base64Variant
fields.label: Base64 Variant
fields.description: The Base64 alphabet to emit: Standard, URL-safe, or Auto (behaves as Standard). URL-safe uses '-' and '_' with no '=' padding.

selectOptions.label: Standard
selectOptions.description: Standard Base64 alphabet (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '+' and '/') with '=' padding.

selectOptions.label: URL-safe
selectOptions.description: URL-safe Base64 alphabet ('-' and '_' in place of '+' and '/'), without '=' padding.

selectOptions.label: Auto
selectOptions.description: Decode-only: accepts both alphabets; on encode behaves as Standard.
